targets.authors: Jones M, Onslow M, Harrison E, Packman A.
targets.title: Treating stuttering in young children: predicting treatment time in the Lidcombe Program.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study, conducted independently in the UK, was designed to replicate the Australian study. Direct replication enabled pooling of the data from the two studies in a meta-analysis.
targets.outcome_quote: Results indicated that Stage 1 of the Lidcombe Program was completed in a median of 11 clinic visits, which is in line with the findings of the Australian study. Stuttering rate at first clinic visit was again found to be a significant predictor of treatment time. The remaining data trends were similar to those in the Australian data.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly compare the new British sample with the Australian study and report agreement in completion time, severity prediction, and remaining trends. Additional meta-analytic predictor is separate from the independent replication verdict.
